summary: Solo hiker fell off a cliff at the Little Park Trailhead; found by other hikers on the Ribbon Trail off Andy's Loop; Grand Junction Fire Rescue 1 crew hiked in with a Stokes basket and packaged the patient; Mesa County SAR ground team + supervisor assisted moving the patient to a landing zone; St. Mary's CareFlight 4 evacuated the patient; incident took just under two hours.
location: Little Park Trailhead / Ribbon Trail off Andy's Loop
responding_agency: Grand Junction Fire Department; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Mesa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Dispatch 12:09 p.m. May 2, 2020; patient hiking alone; patient condition at press time unreported beyond helo evac. Dedupe: 2020-05-01/02/03 date+location window and Wernke/Little Park token scans — no collisions.
